# HSCStack

> An open source academic community and learning ecosystem for the students of Bangladesh.

HSCStack brings Bangladeshi HSC and SSC students together into an active academic community. It combines a structured academic resource library with a student Q&A forum, real-time live chat, study progress tracking, peer networking, educational blogging, and an AI study companion.

## Founder & Maintainer

- **Tajim**
  - Profile: https://hscstack.site/u/trtajim
  - GitHub: https://github.com/trtajim
  - Facebook: https://facebook.com/trtajim

## Main Features & URLs

- [Academic Library (HSC)](https://hscstack.site/): Structured syllabus resources for HSC curriculum organized by subject and chapter.
- [Academic Library (SSC)](https://hscstack.site/ssc): Structured syllabus resources for SSC curriculum organized by subject and chapter.
- [Q&A Forum](https://hscstack.site/forum): Community discussion board to ask questions, post solutions, and upvote helpful answers.
- [Study Tracker](https://hscstack.site/tracker): Personal dashboard to log study time, track syllabus completion, and monitor streaks.
- [Live Chat](https://hscstack.site/chat): Real-time global chat room with instant messaging and community moderation.
- [Peers Directory](https://hscstack.site/peers): Searchable student directory and public learner profiles.
- [Community Blog](https://hscstack.site/blogs): Educational articles, study guides, exam strategies, and subject roadmaps.
- [AI Assistant](https://hscstack.site/ai): Subject-aligned AI study companion for clarifying concepts and solving problems.

## Community & Information

- [Join as Contributor](https://hscstack.site/join): Application portal for verified content contributors.
- [Support Desk](https://hscstack.site/support): Platform helpdesk and user ticketing.
- [Donate](https://hscstack.site/donate): Support open-source infrastructure and maintenance.
- [Terms of Service](https://hscstack.site/terms-service): Platform usage terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hscstack.site/privacy-policy): User privacy and data protection terms.
- [Content Policy](https://hscstack.site/content-policy): Community rules and academic integrity guidelines.
